title: Enemies tagged 'armor useless' (barrow-wight, gray sergeant, Lost Sentry, honour guard) never warn you before the fight starts that your armor investment (Shield Wall, Iron Skin, Unbowed, mail shirt) will do nothing — you only learn it from the combat log after taking the first hit, and by then you've already committed to the encounter.
where: Barrow Crypt / The Waiting Bough / The Moor Road / The Old Crypts — first hit of each 'armor useless' fight
